objective: Determine whether the standalone H67 ATLIF inference module requires spatially indexed or cross-frame persistent state SRAM, while keeping system weight/config memory and all performance claims open.
required_checks: Verify every frozen input SHA before analysis.
Inspect the ATLIFTernaryPSN forward output dependency and separate inference output state from training/calibration observers.
Verify that the integrated RTL drains raw, intermediate, product, and FIFO state before context release.
Reconcile the frozen S10 ordered trace into T10 and T2 ATLIF populations.
Compute the explicit tile-local working payload and bind its existing standard-cell mapping.
Keep system weight/config memory, Fixed comparison, rank3 accuracy, power, energy, PPA, and all speedups open.

admission_rule.go: The module may close the standalone persistent-state-SRAM objection only if output depends on current x_seq plus frozen parameters/buffers, all tile work drains before release, and no external persistent-state port exists.
admission_rule.no_go: Any recurrent value on the output dependency path, any state surviving release, any cross-frame/spatial state port, or any identity drift keeps the state macro gap open.
